name: askaribank-monorepo
description: Global workspace runner for AskariBank digital portals and edge services

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix askaribank && npm install --prefix askaribank/backend && npm install --prefix backend
scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:askaribank" "npm run dev:worker"
scripts.clean: rimraf node_modules frontend/node_modules askaribank/node_modules askaribank/backend/node_modules backend/node_modules
